scripts.check: vp check package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts tools playwright.baseline.config.ts tests performance && vp exec node tools/verify-source-snapshot.mjs
scripts.test: vp run check && vp exec playwright test --config playwright.baseline.config.ts tests
scripts.test:update: vp exec playwright test --config playwright.baseline.config.ts tests --update-snapshots
scripts.perf: vp exec playwright test --config playwright.baseline.config.ts performance/neon-overdrive.perf.spec.ts
